title: The hybrid's extra cost grows sharply under concurrent load
caption: With one client, Hybrid-512 is about 6 ms slower than ML-KEM-768 (35.4 vs. 29.2 ms; Table 3, mean of 100 runs). With 100 concurrent clients the gap is about 110 ms, or 50.9% (Table 5). Concurrency results are one trial per configuration and load level, with synchronized connections.
